name: IssuerKey
title: Issuer signing key
description:
The DSC private key of the issuing participant, in an HSM, cloud KMS or Android Keystore; signs the bytes the issuing system prepares (two-phase signing, STT-ISS-004).

**Persona**: A key that signs what it is given and reveals nothing else.

**Also known as**: Document signer (DSC) key

**Played in the journeys by** (fictional):

- XXR document signer key (Country A, Taifafeki)

**In the user scenarios**:

- [J1 — Vaccinated and recorded](scenarios.html#j1--vaccinated-and-recorded-taifafeki-birth-day): J1 A baby from Onesa is born in Taifafeki
- [J4.0 — Continuity across a border: one family, one phone](scenarios.html#j40--continuity-across-a-border-one-family-one-phone-onesa-12-months-later): J4.0b Dad creates a link to share at the clinic
